political_bridge: Data-center conditions can increase delivered-power and construction costs or delay revenue conversion; useful contracted capacity can retain scarcity value. AI regulation affects particular deployments, not automatically all cloud sales.
decision_gate: Underwrite monetization, depreciation and power commitments together; require the central case to meet the return hurdle before adding.

business_evidence: July 29 Q2 release reports 24% sales growth, 18% organic growth and 22.6% adjusted operating margin. These quarterly adjusted measures are not substituted for the TTM GAAP input.
political_bridge: Permitting restrictions affect backlog conversion, installation timing, utilization and working capital. They do not establish cancellation of every equipment order or a national construction ban.
decision_gate: A falling stock is not enough: test the growth needed to offset compression, and compare with project delivery and order conversion.
invalidation: Backlog converts faster than assumed, or mix and margins support sustained earnings growth outside the scenario range.

business_evidence: August 20 release reports 5.9% quarterly revenue growth and 2.6% US comparable sales growth. EPS growth assumptions also require margin, mix and share-count judgments.
political_bridge: Affordability pressure can support traffic and trade-down while squeezing merchandise margins through wages, imports and cost pass-through. Defensive demand need not imply defensive share returns.

decision_gate: Assess normalization downside before increasing an energy hedge after sector outperformance; dividends would improve total return but are excluded here.
invalidation: Supply, production mix or structural costs change enough to move sustainable earnings outside the cases.

business_evidence: July 21 results report a 20% cancellation rate versus 17% a year earlier and expectations of elevated incentives.
political_bridge: Affordability depends on mortgage payments, incomes, supply and incentives. A change in Congress or lower Fed policy rate does not itself deliver lower mortgage rates or stronger buyer demand.
decision_gate: Add only when order quality, cancellations and incentive expense support the earnings recovery required by the price.
invalidation: Employment weakens, mortgage spreads widen or land/incentive costs overwhelm demand improvement.

invalidation: Medical utilization, reimbursement or business mix differs materially from the assumed recovery.

business_evidence: July 14 Q2 release discusses net interest income through balances and rates; loan demand, deposit pricing and credit costs remain distinct drivers.
political_bridge: A lower policy-rate path can reduce funding expense while also changing asset yields, loan demand and credit losses. Congressional control is not a direct monetary-policy instruction.
decision_gate: Test deposit pricing, loan growth and credit losses together; compare banks with distinct funding structures before using financials as a simple rate hedge.
invalidation: Credit or deposit competition materially changes the earnings trajectory.
